title: Compatibility and cohort evidence ledger
description: Versioned ledger for independent operator trials. Start empty where no evidence exists. Do not manufacture testers or results. Security reviews stay separate from compatibility rows.

metricsDefinitions.installationSuccess: Expected external UDP and TCP answers from a permitted client; REFUSED when denied
metricsDefinitions.timeToFirstQuery: Wall time from ready dashboard to first confirmed external client query; prerequisites timed separately
metricsDefinitions.unexpectedFailuresPerAttemptedQuery: Failures divided by attempted queries in the recorded window
metricsDefinitions.investigationTaskUsefulness: Operator-reported usefulness of Investigate/Map/decision evidence for one synthetic task
metricsDefinitions.retention7d30d: Still running at 7 and 30 days, with leave reasons if not
